plan.title: Single-stage forward auction with optional terms

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a single-stage auction awarding the lot to one vendor.
Select the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is configured.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.

args.goal: In the Terms & Conditions drawer, add two clauses and leave every clause non-mandatory; stop on the terms screen showing both clauses and no clause marked mandatory

steps.note: Configure the two optional terms, which has no dedicated catalog domain step.
Add one QA test vendor to the auction.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the published auction's vendor bid sheet.
Submit a bid of 100 without accepting any mandatory terms, since all clauses are optional.
Verify the vendor portal shows the auction bid as submitted.
